clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms: "I hereby exempt the said Nelson S. Thompson from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending September 30, 1941.". Recorded as 1941-09-30, inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day) under the owner's 2026-10-21 ruling; the exclusive reading ends it when that day begins. Actor: EO 8402 itself. MOMMSEN-I rechecked this stated end against both held witnesses.

research_rationale:
EO:8402: producer recheck of the full held APP working text against the held GPO printing, with exact APP page record/hash verification. One operative personal exemption states its own end, 1941-09-30, inclusive; the exclusive reading (ending when that day begins) is disclosed. A fixed term supplies expiry without assuming any actual retirement, separation or performance event. The held APP and GPO wording agree on beneficiary, authority, operative exemption and stated ending; differences are spacing, capitalization, punctuation and GPO extraction artifacts. The OFR note explicitly says Revoked by: EO 8896, September 12, 1941; this is an asserted earlier-end candidate (1941-09-12), not omitted evidence. The complete held APP and GPO texts of EO 8896 recite the prior exemption and further exempt the same employee for one year ending September 30, 1942; neither contains a revocation, rescission, shortening or supersession command. A further grant can coexist with the earlier permission through its stated term. I therefore do not infer an earlier revocation from the editorial label; the operative source supports the stated own-term end. This is a producer replacement proposal, not independent review or owner adoption. original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
